info.title: Tinify Universal API
info.description: Compress, convert, resize, preserve metadata, and store optimized AVIF, WebP, JPEG, and PNG images with the Tinify API.

post.description: Compresses an uploaded image file in Tinify.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

file.description: AVIF, WebP, JPEG, or PNG image file to optimize.

ratio.description: Compression ratio when returned by Tinify.

size.description: Optimized image size in bytes when returned by Tinify.

type.description: Optimized image MIME type when returned by Tinify.

url.description: Tinify output URL for the optimized image when returned by Tinify.

width.description: Optimized image width in pixels when returned by Tinify.
